# Neon Runner

Guide a glowing dot through an endless, procedurally‑generated maze of rotating bars on an HTML canvas. The dot moves forward automatically; the player can rotate left/right to steer. Colliding with any bar ends the game (lose condition). Collect floating neon orbs to boost score and briefly slow obstacles.

<content>
1: // Neon Runner – minimal implementation
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the hosting HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6: 
7:   // Audio assets
8:   const bgMusic = new Audio('https://actions.google.com/sounds/v1/ambiences/space_ambient.ogg');
9:   bgMusic.loop = true;
10:   bgMusic.volume = 0.2;
11:   const collectSound = new Audio('https://actions.google.com/sounds/v1/cartoon/medium_thing.mp3');
12:   const crashSound = new Audio('https://actions.google.com/sounds/v1/cartoon/clang_and_wobble.ogg');
13:   let audioStarted = false;
14:   const startAudio = () => {
15:     if (!audioStarted) {
16:       bgMusic.play();
17:       audioStarted = true;
18:     }
19:   };
20:   const resize = () => {
21:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
22:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
23:   };
24:   resize();
25:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
26: 
27:   // Player (glowing dot)
28:   const player = {
29:   trail: [] // recent positions for glow trail
30:     x: canvas.width / 2,
31:     y: canvas.height - 60,
32:     r: 5,
33:     angle: -Math.PI / 2, // up
34:     speed: 2,
35:     turn: 0,
36:   };
37: 
38:   // Input handling (left / right arrows)
39:   const keys = {};
40:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') keys.left = true; if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') keys.right = true; startAudio(); });
41:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') keys.left = false; if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') keys.right = false; });
42: 
43:   let obstacles = [];
44:   let orbs = [];
45:   let score = 0;
46:   let slowTimer = 0;
47:   let gameOver = false;
48: 
49:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
50: 
51:   const addObstacle = () => {
52:     const w = rand(50, 120);
53:     const h = 8;
54:     obstacles.push({
55:       x: rand(w / 2, canvas.width - w / 2),
56:       y: -20,
57:       w,
58:       h,
59:       angle: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
60:       rotSpeed: rand(-0.07, 0.07),
61:     });
62:   };
63: 
64:   const addOrb = () => {
65:     const radius = 4;
66:     orbs.push({
67:       x: rand(radius, canvas.width - radius),
68:       y: -20,
69:       r: radius,
70:     });
71:   };
72: 
73:   const update = () => {
74:     if (gameOver) return;
75:     // player rotation
76:     if (keys.left) player.turn = -0.04;
77:     else if (keys.right) player.turn = 0.04;
78:     else player.turn = 0;
79:     player.angle += player.turn;
80:     // move player forward
81:     const spd = player.speed;
82:     player.x += Math.cos(player.angle) * spd;
83:     player.y += Math.sin(player.angle) * spd;
84: 
85:     // keep player inside canvas (wrap)
86:     if (player.x < 0) player.x += canvas.width;
87:     if (player.x > canvas.width) player.x -= canvas.width;
88:     if (player.y < 0) player.y += canvas.height;
89:     if (player.y > canvas.height) player.y -= canvas.height;
90: 
91:     // update trail – store recent positions with fading alpha
92:     player.trail.push({x: player.x, y: player.y, alpha: 0.8});
93:     if (player.trail.length > 12) player.trail.shift();
94:     // fade older points
95:     player.trail.forEach(p => { p.alpha *= 0.85; });
96: 
97:     const obstacleSpeed = slowTimer ? spd * 0.4 : spd;
98:     // update obstacles
99:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
100:       o.y += obstacleSpeed;
101:       o.angle += o.rotSpeed;
102:     });
103:     obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.y - o.h < canvas.height);
104:     // spawn obstacles
105:     if (obstacles.length < 12) addObstacle();
106: 
107:     // update orbs
108:     orbs.forEach(o => { o.y += obstacleSpeed; });
109:     orbs = orbs.filter(o => o.y - o.r < canvas.height);
110:     if (orbs.length < 5 && Math.random() < 0.02) addOrb();
111: 
112:     // collision detection (simple circle‑vs‑circle approximation)
113:     for (const o of obstacles) {
114:       const dx = player.x - o.x;
115:       const dy = player.y - o.y;
116:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
117:       if (dist < player.r + Math.max(o.w, o.h) / 2) { gameOver = true; crashSound.play(); break; }
118:     }
119:     // collect orbs
120:     for (let i = orbs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
121:       const o = orbs[i];
122:       const dx = player.x - o.x;
123:       const dy = player.y - o.y;
124:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < player.r + o.r) {
125:         score += 10;
126:         slowTimer = 180; // ~3 seconds at 60fps
127:         orbs.splice(i, 1);
128:         collectSound.currentTime = 0;
129:         collectSound.play();
130:       }
131:     }
132:     if (slowTimer) slowTimer--;
133:     score += 0.02; // distance based increment
134:   };
135: 
136:   const draw = () => {
137:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
138:     // draw background gradient
139:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
140:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
141:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
142:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
143:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
144: 
145:     // draw player trail (fading neon)
146:     ctx.save();
147:     ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
148:     for (let i = 0; i < player.trail.length; i++) {
149:       const p = player.trail[i];
150:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,255,255,${p.alpha})`;
151:       ctx.beginPath();
152:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, player.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
153:       ctx.fill();
154:     }
155:     ctx.restore();
156: 
157:     // draw player with glow
158:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
159:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
160:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
161:     ctx.beginPath();
162:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
163:     ctx.fill();
164:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
165:     // draw obstacles (rotating bars)
166:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
167:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
168:       ctx.save();
169:       ctx.translate(o.x, o.y);
170:       ctx.rotate(o.angle);
171:       ctx.fillRect(-o.w / 2, -o.h / 2, o.w, o.h);
172:       ctx.restore();
173:     });
174:     // draw orbs
175:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
176:     orbs.forEach(o => {
177:       ctx.beginPath();
178:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
179:       ctx.fill();
180:     });
181:     // UI
182:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
183:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
184:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
185:     if (gameOver) {
186:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
187:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
188:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
189:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
190:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
191:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
192:     }
193:   };
194: 
195:   const loop = () => {
196:     update();
197:     draw();
198:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
199:   };
200:   loop();
201: })();

(End of file - total 201 lines)
</content>
